creator: Alexander Terp
description: macOS scans a new binary on its first run. Measured here: 44 s for a freshly built app and 16 s for the debug daemon, then milliseconds. The app gives the daemon it starts 10 s, so a person's first launch of a downloaded release may report the daemon as failed. Unverified for a notarized release (the scan may be faster or skipped): measure one on a clean machine, and if it can exceed the wait, wait longer on first launch or say why in the window.
title: A first launch may time out waiting for its daemon while macOS scans it
